# rotostats

Statistics for Rotisserie Baseball Auction Leagues.

## Installation

``` r
# From GitHub (development version)
pak::pak("JDenn0514/rotostats")

# From r-universe (pre-built binaries, no GitHub PAT needed)
install.packages("rotostats", repos = "https://jdenn0514.r-universe.dev")
```

## Usage

``` r
library(rotostats)
```

## Learn more

See the [pkgdown site](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/) for full
documentation.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`after()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/after.md)
  : Year-window helper: years strictly after a threshold
- [`as.double(`*`<sgp_denominators>`*`)`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/as.double.sgp_denominators.md)
  : Coerce sgp_denominators to a named numeric vector
- [`before()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/before.md)
  : Year-window helper: years strictly before a threshold
- [`between()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/between.md)
  : Year-window helper: years within an inclusive range
- [`cal()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/cal.md) :
  Per-category calibration override constructor
- [`cal_spec()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/cal_spec.md)
  : Per-category calibration spec constructor
- [`convert_rate_stats()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/convert_rate_stats.md)
  : Convert rate statistics to counting-stat equivalents (stub)
- [`exp_decay()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/exp_decay.md)
  : Exponential decay weight constructor for SGP denominator calibration
- [`expected_range_normal()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/expected_range_normal.md)
  : Expected range of n standard normal variables
- [`flat()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/flat.md) :
  Flat (equal) weight constructor for SGP denominator calibration
- [`last()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/last.md) :
  Year-window helper: the n most recent years
- [`length(`*`<sgp_denominators>`*`)`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/length.sgp_denominators.md)
  : Length of an sgp_denominators object
- [`linear_decay()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/linear_decay.md)
  : Linear decay weight constructor for SGP denominator calibration
- [`names(`*`<sgp_denominators>`*`)`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/names.sgp_denominators.md)
  : Names of an sgp_denominators object
- [`print(`*`<sgp_denominators>`*`)`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/print.sgp_denominators.md)
  : Print method for sgp_denominators objects
- [`sgp_denominators()`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/sgp_denominators.md)
  : Compute SGP denominators for rotisserie scoring categories
- [`` `[`( ``*`<sgp_denominators>`*`)`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/sub-.sgp_denominators.md)
  : Single-bracket subscript for sgp_denominators
- [`` `[[`( ``*`<sgp_denominators>`*`)`](https://jdenn0514.github.io/rotostats/reference/sub-sub-.sgp_denominators.md)
  : Double-bracket subscript for sgp_denominators
